fixes.explanation: That's it. "Jesus rebuked the demon. 'Be silent!' He said. 'Come out of him!'" (Luke 4:35). Jesus doesn't argue and doesn't debate. He gives two short commands, and the demon comes out. The demon throws the man down before them all, but it comes out without harming him.

That's right, friend. "…laying His hands on each one, He healed them." (Luke 4:40). At sunset, all who were ill with various diseases were brought to Him. Jesus doesn't stop at a few. He heals each one.
